node.title: Re: Length of String
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: What you are storing in $overwrite is the return value of the > operator, which will be Perl's version of "boolean" values - see [id://11104607]. If you wanted to store other values, you could use the [doc://perlop#Conditional-Operator]: my $overwrite = length($function) ? "true" : "false"; (those are two strings that are both considered "true" in Perl).
